SOC 29-1123

Physical Therapists by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Physical Therapists have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $107,290 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $107,290, Chicago $105,720, Austin $103,630.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
